subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Does the July 6 live 2026.6.10 reproduction provide enough proof to adopt or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88841 despite the still-unidentified public owner transition?
rationale: Automation cannot safely decide whether production field logs outweigh the missing public-state reproduction for a gateway reconnect state-machine change that could affect shutdown and reconnect semantics.

options.title: Owner-review and revise the candidate PR
options.body: Use this issue's fresh live capture as proof input, require promoted logging and tests, and let the Discord owner decide whether the close-handler mitigation is acceptable.

options.title: Require root-cause transition proof first
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a public lifecycle path reproduces the stale reconnect flag and the repair can move to that owner transition.

options.title: Add channel-scoped recovery only as fallback
options.body: If automatic reconnect remains risky, add a turn-safe Discord account reconnect control while preserving the primary auto-reconnect bug as separate work.

recommendation.title: Owner-review and revise the candidate PR
recommendation.body: Use this issue's fresh live capture as proof input, require promoted logging and tests, and let the Discord owner decide whether the close-handler mitigation is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent left the maintainer proof objection on the candidate PR and has recent adjacent Discord lifecycle history.
